Streamlined_Shark_Cartilage_Chassis.description: Enveloped in a sleek, natural armor of shark cartilage, this piscine chassis grants unparalleled agility and speed, allowing for swift underwater dashes and acrobatic maneuvers that slice through currents with deadly precision.

Armored_Sturgeon_Scute_Core.description: Embedded within the robust frame of this armored sturgeon, the scute core serves as a fortress of natural defenses, granting formidable protection against harm while its cumbersome bulk hinders nimble movements, making it a formidable presence in aquatic battles.

Deep_Sea_Angler_Bulbous_Frame.description: The Deep Sea Angler's Bulbous Frame is a mystical, piscine core that grants enhanced wisdom and resilience, enabling the wielder to emit an ethereal light and cast a mesmerizing lure, perfect for navigating the treacherous depths and ensnaring prey from afar.

Venomous_Lionfish_Spine_Chassis.description: Embedded within the sleek, piscine chassis of the venomous lionfish, this core component not only grants the user enhanced dexterity and constitution but also the formidable abilities to unleash a poisonous cloud and resist its own toxic effects, mirroring the deadly elegance of its aquatic namesake.

Slippery_Eel_Serpentine_Core.description: Embedded within the serpentine form of this entity is a core that pulses with the essence of ancient, shadowy waters, granting unparalleled agility and stealth, allowing it to glide through even the thorniest terrain with the fluid grace of a slippery eel.

Camouflaging_Flounder_Flat_Frame.description: The Camouflaging Flounder Flat Frame is a sleek, piscine chassis that melds seamlessly with its surroundings, enhancing the user’s stealth and agility as it moves through water with effortless grace, granting the ability to remain hidden even in the most revealing environments.

Heavy_Coelacanth_Lobe_Chassis.description: The Heavy Coelacanth Lobe Chassis is a formidable piscine core that grants its bearer immense strength and a natural armor akin to ancient, bony scales, making it nearly impervious to knockback while enhancing its ability to traverse both land and water with ease.

Bioluminescent_Viperfish_Frame.description: The Bioluminescent Viperfish Frame is a sleek and deadly aquatic chassis, its dark, translucent scales emit a mesmerizing glow in the deep abyss, enhancing its keen perception and wisdom to navigate the treacherous depths while deploying a cloud of paralyzing venom to ensnare unsuspecting prey.

Electric_Ray_Cartilaginous_Core.description: Embedded deep within the sleek, electrically charged body of the piscine creature, the cartilaginous core pulses with arcane energy, granting unparalleled agility and a keen sense of magical awareness, allowing it to dash through water with the grace of a predator and reflect hostile spells back upon their caster.

Ghost_Koi_Spectral_Chassis.description: The Ghost Koi Spectral Chassis is a spectral aquatic entity, its translucent form shimmering with an otherworldly luminescence, capable of both swimming gracefully through water and hovering silently in the air, enhancing its already formidable stealth and evasion capabilities.
